subject: ubms - model will not stop cycling

messages.author: b3a6b1169042dcca
messages.subject: ubms - model will not stop cycling
parts:
Dear Ken (and ALL)

I'm using ubms for pcount models. I start simply and build up their complexity. I have had success with the following six models on a dataset previously. However, for my most recent dataset one model (mod_cov_1) just will not complete the cycle and is stuck at the end of chain 4 processing. 

I have tried different computers, one with higher memory. All the other models run well (40 mins - 2hr 30). I left mod_cov_1 running overnight as I considered I may not have been patient enough. No change. I am using the latest R Studio and R (4.3.2).

Any advice welcome. Many thanks. This is an excellent group forum.

Todd Lewis - UWE Bristol

###############################################################
#Null mod: fixed detection + fixed abundance + no effects
(mod_null_0 <- stan_pcount(~1 ~1,
                          K=20, chains=4, iter=2000,
                          UMF, seed=2023, cores=6)) #iter2000 final

#Null mod: N surveys effs on detection + fixed abund + no effs
(mod_null_1 <- stan_pcount(~scale(Depth) ~1,
                          K=20, chains=4, iter=2000,
                          UMF, seed=2023, cores=6))

#Covariate mod: fixed detection + Location covariate effects
(mod_cov_1 <- stan_pcount(~1 ~Location,
                          K=20, chains=4, iter=2000,
                          UMF, seed=2023, cores=6))

#Covariate mod: N surveys effs on det + Location cov effects
(mod_cov_2 <- stan_pcount(~scale(Depth)
                          ~Location,
                          K=20, chains=4, iter=2000,
                          UMF, seed=2023, cores=6))

#Random intercept mod: fixed det + Location cov + rand int
(mod_rand_1 <- stan_pcount(~1
                         ~Location +(1|Distance),
                         K=20, chains=4, iter=2000,  
                         UMF, seed=2023, cores=6))

#Rand int mod: N surveys on det + Location cov + rand int
(mod_rand_2 <- stan_pcount(~scale(Depth)
                         ~Location +(1|Distance),
                         K=20, chains=4, iter=2000,  
                         UMF, seed=2023, cores=6))

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] ubms - model will not stop cycling
parts:
I've seen Stan hang like this before, but haven't found there to be some specific common reason for it.

Have you tried running with fewer iterations to see if it still gets stuck? Or set a different seed? Or maybe try running not in parallel just in case that's somehow part of the issue?

Basically, I'd just tinker with these things and other arguments until (hopefully) you find something that affects the problem.

Ken

messages.author: b3a6b1169042dcca
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] ubms - model will not stop cycling
parts:
Hi Ken

Thanks for the very swift and helpful response. Quick update.

I found the secret formula to get over the frozen model. It successfully completed cycling after reducing the iterations to 1500 and changing the seed to 2020. As you suggest this seems to be a strange "Stan-ism" hang-up and not a problem at the ubms end.

Am very much enjoying using ubms - and thank you, and the group, for all your great work!

Todd
